notes.title: Update - 11 July 2024
notes.content:
Hey friends, listening to your feedback we decided to create a quick patch in order to fix a few issues some of you encountered:
[BugFix] - Main gates couldn't be opened from certain positions
[BugFix] - Leaving a lobby would leave the player in the lobby's voice chat
[Improvement] - Added a journal pop-up in game to help new players
